facts.text: I am working in an Ignition tag event change scripting window to push data on value change of a tag using named queries to a database.
I read the tag "[System]Gateway/CurrentDateTime" into p1.
I read the tag "[.]Machine Name" into p2.
I read the tag "[.]Stage" into p3.
I read the tag "[.]Shift" into p4.
I read the tag "[.]MIS_Running_Recipe" into p5.
I read step sequence names from "[.]../step_sequence_name/step1" through "[.]../step_sequence_name/step14" into p6s1 through p6s14.
I read step sequence codes from "[.]../step_sequence_number/step1" through "[.]../step_sequence_number/step14" into p7s1 through p7s14.
I read step sequence times from "[.]../step_sequence_value/step1" through "[.]../step_sequence_value/step14" into p8s1 through p8s14.
I read the tag "[.]CT_SEC" into p9.
I build parameter dictionaries params_s1 through params_s14 for named query execution.
Each params_sN dictionary includes keys "R_Datetime", "Machine_Name", "Stage", "R_Shift", "Building_Recipe", "Sequence_Name", "Sequence_Code", "Sequence_Time", and "Cycle_Time".
I call system.db.runNamedQuery with project "Tag_Details" and named query path "Throughput_Building_MS/SeqWise_Data_Push".
I execute the named query for step N only when previousValue.value != currentValue.value, currentValue.value == False, and p8sN > 0.00.
I execute the named query separately for steps 1 through 14 using params_s1 through params_s14.
I want to optimize the code to avoid executing system.db.runnamedquery multiple times.
I want to optimize the Params sequence-wise.
I want to optimize the final if conditions and the checking with p8 before running the named query.
I want the output as text instead of a code screen because the code is lengthy and output generation gets stuck.

events.text: Named query execution condition check and run for each step when previousValue differs and currentValue is False and p8sN > 0.00
